assembly_object: UPS with existing battery holder and cells
basis: User requested slight battery size variation and bottom foam shimming space. Allowance is an engineering assumption around the existing complete UPS/holder/cell assembly.
mounting_interface: Existing UPS mounting holes and intended mounting hardware remain fixed; allowance does not enlarge the battery holder's internal cell dimensions.
foam_note: Optional footprints on the removable flat cradle. Reserve up to 2mm compressed thickness including adhesive; choose actual thickness after measuring and confirm contact with insulated holder. Keep clear of screws, wiring and airflow. Foam does not replace stack fasteners.

side_vents.decision: User cancelled the proposed symmetric side vents; retain front and rear openings only.
